biocontainers.name: bioconductor-recount3
biocontainers.summary: Explore and download data from the recount3 project

biotools.summary: The recount3 package enables access to a large amount of uniformly processed RNA-seq data from human and mouse. You can download RangedSummarizedExperiment objects at the gene, exon or exon-exon junctions level with sample metadata and QC statistics. In addition we provide access to sample coverage BigWig files.
